Agentic AI Foundation is the neutral, open home of MCP, goose and AGENTS.md, a Linux Foundation project formed in 2025. It serves AI platform teams building agents and the developers of agent frameworks and tools, with 3 founding projects under open governance and more than 10,000 published MCP servers.

Agentic AI Foundation is the neutral, open home of MCP, goose and AGENTS.md, a Linux Foundation project formed in 2025 so that the protocols agents run on stay open and no single vendor controls them. It serves AI platform teams building agents, enterprises adopting agentic AI and the developers of agent frameworks and tools. Its 3 founding projects are governed openly, with more than 10,000 published MCP servers and 8 Platinum members at launch sustaining the work. Members steer the foundation through working groups and the Technical Committee, and the community meets at AGNTCon and MCPCon. Learn more at aaif.io.
